scope.review_type: independent source-only review of temporary diagnostic overlay and scratch runners; no build or runtime qualification

concurrent_changes.method: Final six source hashes still compared against exact hashes read at start and terminal worker handoff; no full-tree concurrency claim.

checks.exact_timing_scope: Four fixed phases. Semantic guard brackets existing apply_with_result including edit.request argument setup, and ends before staged size charge/replacement/refresh. Replay guard brackets the ordinary apply_with_result(...)? .1 expression and ends before post-size charge/identity ledger/visitor. Isolation branch unchanged. These two spans are disjoint sequential calls for the specified one-leaf workload, contained by service outer route; they are inclusive apply costs, not reducer-only costs.
checks.outer_success_publication: Activation sits only in non-annotation user request dispatch and requires ProjectRequest::Macro plus exact env value 1. Outer guard starts immediately before original dispatch expression and drops after busy/reconciliation/shared publish. Marker occurs only after successful existing refresh, with original success/failure result branches retained. Output takes the snapshot after publication and outer drop; absent/duplicate marker or overflow discards output.
checks.error_and_tls_lifecycle: Leaf ? errors naturally drop active spans; unchanged service handling converts those failures into request receipts, then normal post-dispatch take clears the snapshot even when no success marker exists. begin refuses nesting without replacing an active snapshot. No catch_unwind loop was found on the service thread: a panic unwinds/drops spans and terminates that thread, so no stale buffer can contaminate a later request on it. This is not a general RAII activation API for arbitrary external callers.
checks.gate_off: With no activated snapshot, Span::start uses lazy bool::then(Instant::now), so no clock is read. App exact gate short-circuits begin; mark_refresh_success performs no clock. finish/output is not called. Disabled TLS/branch overhead remains and requires control qualification.
checks.checked_counters: Elapsed u128 and count u64 accumulation use checked_add; failure sets overflowed and suppresses report without changing saved result. Marker duration is constant zero. No measurements contain IDs, media, dynamic phase labels or authored fields.
checks.semantics_and_authority: Five existing-file diffs are imports/export, guards, final numeric output and equivalent temporary refresh-result binding. Existing fallible expressions, validation, allocation, charges, mutation, publication and success/failure handling remain. No Store/runtime adapter/source API/manifest changes. Diagnostic I/O is best-effort after work on service thread and cannot turn ordinary I/O failure into a saved-result error; malformed/partial/missing output must invalidate evidence.
checks.parser: Strict six prefix-line block, exact BEGIN/END, ordered constant phase/kind rows, fullmatch decimal syntax, u64/u128 limits, exact count=1, zero-time marker, checked disjoint sum and nonnegative outer residual. Rejects extra blocks/rows, unknown lines containing prefix and malformed lines; bounds per-line and total bytes. Gate-off mode requires complete profile absence. Synthetic cases cover these but were not run.
checks.observer_ownership: Observer launches executable directly through existing guarded spawn with process_group(0), keeps sole Child ownership, samples only owned_child_memory(&child), never uses arbitrary PID or try_wait and never reaps while sampling. Ok(None) ends sampling before cleanup and sole wait.
checks.observer_cleanup: Every ordinary post-spawn terminal path enters checked group teardown with monotonic deadline; failure attempts checked leader fallback. wait is attempted once only after confirmed exit, with reap_attempted set before wait. Group failure remains explicit and invalid even after leader fallback. Unconfirmed exit skips wait and records possible remaining child/descendants. Setup/output allocation happens before spawn; raw samples/receipt writing happens after cleanup.
checks.observer_evidence: Bounded 60000 rows/180-second cooperative runtime, 5ms requested gaps plus actual sample/query timestamps, checked counts/query sums and explicit errors. Trial requires natural exit, samples, no errors, group confirmation, successful sole reap/app exit and sample output. Zero samples retain null maxima. Maxima are correctly labeled sampled whole-main-app lower bounds, not exact/per-leaf/worker/GPU peaks.

limitations: No source edits, formatter, Cargo, build, parser tests, runtime, profiling or Git actions performed by reviewer.
All compilation, runtime counts/containment, failure injection, output behavior, observer permission/linkage and overhead calibration remain Root execution work.
Synchronous owned_child_memory/libproc queries are not preempted by the observer cooperative deadline; failed cleanup is reported rather than claimed successful.
Output filenames are trusted scratch-runner inputs; lexical distinctness does not prove distinct filesystem objects under aliasing/symlinks. Root must supply separate fresh files as planned.
Marker proves successful refresh before shared publication; it does not qualify caller/UI consumption or downstream GPU/scanout. Diagnostic stderr may overlap UI consumption.
No performance gain, memory ceiling, per-leaf memory or production release qualification is claimed.
